site.description: An aggregator of React and Tailwind UI components gathered from shadcn/ui, Magic UI and other libraries, sorted by category, each with a live preview, its install command and a link to the original. Visitors browse by category or library, search, open a component's page and copy its install command; coding agents use it through /mcp, /api/alternatives, /llms.txt and the /skill. The public site is read-only, with no accounts; /polishd is owner-only.
site.audience: Developers building React and Tailwind interfaces, and the coding agents working for them
